svg.title: dsh-excel-reconcile: two ledgers, one key spine, one verdict per field
svg.desc: Side A (AR ledger) and side B (statement) meet at a key spine that normalises keys and applies a join mode. Every matched key is answered field by field in a verdict column — A value, verdict, B value — with compare[] tolerance shown on the field. Keys present on one side only bypass the comparison band and enter the finding taxonomy directly. Eight finding types, split by severity, then fan out to the three artefacts: markdown, resultJson and the five-sheet diff workbook.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace
ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif
